paragraphs: Two Texts About One Eagle, posted by Mia. On Saturday, the Explorers went to the nature park. We joined the eagle camp with Ranger Mark. It was a cool morning, and the park was very green. Before the trip, I read his leaflet. After the trip, I wrote my own post. Here are both texts. Can you find the same facts and the different facts?

Text One: Ranger Mark's Leaflet. Eagle Camp is every Saturday from eight o'clock to noon. An eagle lives in the tall tree near the lake. It is about seventy centimeters long. Its wings are two meters wide. It eats fish and small animals. The camp is for children from nine to twelve years old. A day at the camp costs one hundred baht.

Bring a raincoat, a hat, and a bottle of water. Order your lunch at the park office by Friday. Lunch costs forty baht. Wear strong shoes, because the path is long. The rangers are helpful, so ask them questions. Please do not shout, because the eagle is shy.

Text Two: Mia's Eagle Day. It rained at eight o'clock, so we wore our raincoats. We watched anyway. The rain stopped after half an hour. The lake was quiet and gray. Ranger Mark said, "The eagle does not mind the rain." At nine o'clock, I saw the eagle in the tall tree. Lily and Leo watched with me. The eagle stayed in the tree for ten minutes. It was bigger than I thought, and its wings were two meters wide. Then it flew over the lake and caught a fish. I took twelve photos. May asked Ranger Mark many questions. I ordered my lunch on Friday, and it was chicken and rice. Ranger Mark was very helpful, and he gave us a map of the park.

Both texts tell us the same thing: the eagle lives near the lake. Both give the same size: its wings are two meters wide. The leaflet gives the price, but my post tells about the rain. Which text helps you more? Do you want to join the eagle camp? Tell us in a message!
text.summary: Mia puts two texts about the same eagle on Explorers' Blog. The first is Ranger Mark's leaflet for Eagle Camp, and the second is Mia's post about the day. The two texts share some facts and differ in others.

The sky is gray, but the rain has stopped.
